dex.text: A large, sad, blue-grey bird that steps out of its glass case on a quiet day and looks at you as though you owe it an apology. It has been waiting four hundred years, and it is not in a hurry.
dex.fact: The Oxford Dodo, in the University Museum of Natural History, is the only dodo with soft tissue left anywhere in the world: a head and a foot, saved in 1755 when the Ashmolean's stuffed dodo was thrown out. Lewis Carroll put a Dodo in Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, partly as a joke on his own stammered name, Do-do-Dodgson.
